slides.body: A dasha (planetary period) is a chapter of life coloured by one planet. Mercury (intellect, speech, trade) has a 17-year Mahadasha (major period) in the Vimshottari system.
Too many threads at once. Mercury can mean overthinking, scattered focus and talking more than doing. Pick fewer experiments and finish them.
Check Mercury's sign, house and strength, then the antardasha (sub-period). A dasha describes a tendency, never a guarantee.
